title: U.S. Credit Ratings: Meet Kevin Challenges Trump's Rate Call
description:
Meet Kevin challenges Trump's claim that U.S. credit ratings justify interest rates of 1% or less. This recap credits Meet Kevin's supplied clip, which presents Trump's statement as a response to a Federal Reserve rate increase. Kevin disputes the claim that America has the world's best credit, saying it has lost all three AAA ratings because agencies consider its debt unsustainable. Our take: Financial headlines can heighten household stress, so separate the national debate from the budget decisions you can control. This is commentary, not financial advice.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
